summary.text: Karen Karls is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives who has represented District 35 since 2006 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Karls earned a B.S. in medical technology from Minot State University, according to Ballotpedia, and her professional experience includes working as a wedding cake decorator.
Ballotpedia lists her committee assignments in the 2023-2024 session as vice chair of the House Judiciary Committee and membership on the House Government and Veterans Affairs Committee.
